text: dsh-theme-endfield-style 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的《明日方舟：终末地》风格外观主题，通过插件客户端注入 CSS，并在页面中添加装饰性标题栏、信号侧栏和外观快捷入口。它提供荧光黄侧栏头部、程序生成的等高线图案、浅色与深色配色，以及更紧凑的圆角和边框；标题栏会跟随当前会话名称更新。侧栏快捷入口会打开 DSH 自带的外观设置，保留应用原有的主题偏好。适合希望将 DSH Web 界面调整为工业科幻风格的用户；不需要额外密钥或外部账号。

dsh-theme-endfield-style gives DSH Web an Endfield-inspired look with light and dark palettes, a fluorescent sidebar, procedural contour artwork, and a decorative session masthead. A sidebar shortcut opens DSH’s built-in Appearance settings. No API key or external account is required.
想把 DSH 网页界面换成《终末地》那种工业科幻风格。
给 DSH Web 加上荧光黄侧栏和等高线装饰。
Can I restyle the DSH web interface with an Endfield-inspired theme?
dsh-theme-endfield-style 的功能「终末地风格界面」：插件加载后注入浅色与深色配色、荧光黄侧栏头部和圆角边框，并添加标题栏与信号装饰。
dsh-theme-endfield-style 的功能「会话标题与外观入口」：页面导航变化时更新装饰标题为当前会话名，并在侧栏增加按钮，点击后打开 DSH 原生外观设置。

dsh-theme-endfield-style README · dsh-theme-endfield-style：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A theme in the style of *Arknights: Endfield* for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web UI.
Unofficial fan work, not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's publisher.

| Light | Dark |
|---|---|
|  |  |

dsh-theme-endfield-style README · What it changes：- Fluorescent-yellow sidebar header and a signal rail on the right edge.
- A masthead with a large `DEEPFIELD` background word and procedurally drawn contour lines.
- Engineering grey-white and graphite-black palettes that follow the built-in light / dark / system setting.
- Small corner radii, thin lines, and a shortcut to the built-in Appearance settings in the sidebar.

All artwork is generated in code. There are no image files from the game, no network requests, and no animation loop.

dsh-theme-endfield-style README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-theme-endfield-style
```

Or install it from the Themes tab of [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market). Refresh the page afterwards.

If the package is not on npm yet, install from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Xiaoli-Asuna/dsh-theme-endfield-style
```

dsh-theme-endfield-style README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-theme-endfield-style
```

The theme only adds a `<style>` tag, a few decorative elements, and a `data-endfield-theme` attribute on `<html>`. Removing the plugin removes all of them.

dsh-theme-endfield-style README · Compatibility：Selectors use DSH's hashed component class names (for example `.hHd-Xa_root`). They were verified against DSH `0.1.5-rc.3`. A newer DSH may rename them, and parts of the theme may stop applying until the selectors are updated. Please open an issue with your DSH version if that happens.

dsh-theme-endfield-style README · Build：```sh
npm install
npm run build   # regenerates lib/client.js from src/client.ts and src/styles.css
```
